subject: RP11 Paper Results — 12/15, 80%, Grade 3 — Q11 fractional-exp CORRECT
body:
FR — Mash just reported Kai's RP11 results. Taken on paper before the final today.

SCORE: 12/15 = 80%, Grade 3

Correct: Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, Q5, Q6, Q7, Q8, Q9, Q10, Q11, Q13
Wrong: Q12 (W2.c), Q14 (W2.d), Q15 (W3.a)

Section breakdown:
- Section A (Q1-3): 3/3 - perfect
- Section B (Q4-11): 8/8 - PERFECT, including Q11
- Section C (Q12-13): 1/2 - Q12 graph missed
- Section D (Q14-15): 0/2 - both missed

THE BIG WIN: Q11 (3x^(2/3)-4=104, x=216) was CORRECT. That was the fractional exponent question we built the whole exam around. The one weakness from RP4 is gone. He knows his cube table.

New pattern in the misses:
- Q12 missed: W2.c graph (downward parabola f(x)=-(x-2)^2+16). Prior W2.c rate was 2/2. This is a new miss — likely the downward direction threw him, or he lost points on the interval notation sub-parts.
- Q14 missed: W2.d vertex form features (f(x)=3(x-6)^2-12). Standard he has been strong on. May be the radio direction input or the increasing/decreasing notation.
- Q15 missed: W3.a word problem (decay model). Hardest question in the set — build the model AND solve. Not surprising for a paper test under time pressure.

The real exam is today. What matters going in:
1. W3.b fractional exponent: RESOLVED. He has it.
2. New watch item: graphing features notation (W2.c, W2.d) — interval notation and direction identification under pressure.
3. Word problem setup (W3.a) — needs to remember P(t) = P0 * (base)^(t/T) before he starts solving.

Scores file updated: data/kai-scores-latest.json

Good luck to Kai today.

— GR
